title: NextJS - `createURL` should run server side
body: ### 🐛 Current behavior `createURL` returns an empty URL on the server and only populates on the client. ### 🔍 Steps to reproduce 1. Go the sandbox 2. Disable Javascript 3. Observe that the links are empty ### Live reproduction https://codesandbox.io/p/sandbox/refinement-list-sort-issue-forked-i8kn3o?file=%2Fcomponents%2FRefinementList.js%3A9%2C11 ### 💭 Expected behavior Expect that the links are populated server side. Theoretically this should be possible since we are running `getServerState` on the server and know the UI state prior to SSR. (See https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/issues/5236#issuecomment-1566414241). ### Package version algoliasearch 4.17.1, react-instantsearch-hooks-web 6.44.0 ### Operating system Mac 11.6.5 ### Browser Chrome 113.0.5672.126 ### Code of Conduct - [X] I agree to follow this project's Code of Conduct

comments.body: A side effect of this issue: When you click on a link before the JS is fully loaded, you are taken to the broken link.

Hi @avremel,

Closing this as it's a duplicate of #5236. The fix is coming soon and we'll communicate about it there !
